app.name: Vrmac Living Heritage
app.prototype: Prototype built for the SMART ERA application, September–October 2026. Sample data.
auth.wrongRole: Your account role ({role}) cannot open this screen. Required: {roles}.
auth.failed: Login failed. Check the e-mail and password.
home.lead: One validated source of truth for Gornja Lastva and the Vrmac hill: voice-first onboarding for hosts, grounded answers for visitors, and KPIs computed from events.
home.visitor.desc: Interactive map, directions, trails with condition reports, grounded questions with citations, itineraries.
home.host.desc: Record your offer by voice, confirm the extracted listing, give consent, send it to validation.
home.validate.desc: Validators (Napredak) review drafts; only approved items ever reach visitors.
home.dashboard.desc: KPI table from events only, sex-disaggregated, k≥5 suppression, heat map of measured visits.
home.claims: What is real in this prototype
home.claim1: Validation gate enforced in the database (row-level security) and in every query.
home.claim2: Answers only from approved entries, with citations — or a refusal that is logged.
home.claim3: Voice → transcript → structured listing → consent → validation → publication in two languages.
home.claim4: Every step emits an event; the KPI table is computed from events, never typed in.
home.claim5: OpenStreetMap + MapLibre map, Google Maps navigation links, GPX trails with latest condition report.
home.claim6: NGSI-LD PointOfInterest + DCAT-AP export validated against Smart Data Models.
